player_0.content: New plan: I failed to consider the specific sport-related context of the sentences. In the case of the sentence "Santi Cazorla scored a touchdown," I should have recognized that Santi Cazorla is a soccer player and touchdowns are a feature of American football, not soccer. Next time, I will carefully examine the sport-related context of each sentence and use my knowledge of different sports to determine the plausibility of the sentence.
